argv: import ast,json,pathlib,sys; root=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]); sources=list(root.rglob('*.py')); [ast.parse(p.read_text(encoding='ascii'),filename=str(p),feature_version=(3,11)) for p in sources]; texts=[p for p in root.rglob('*') if p.is_file() and p.suffix in ('.py','.md','.json','.lock')]; bad=[str(p) for p in texts if any(line.rstrip()!=line for line in p.read_text(encoding='ascii').splitlines())]; assert not bad,bad; reports=list(root.rglob('*.json')); [json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='ascii')) for p in reports]; print(json.dumps({'python311_grammar_files':len(sources),'json_files':len(reports),'ascii_whitespace_files':len(texts),'status':'PASS_SOURCE_CHECKS_ONLY'},sort_keys=True))
